blockingFinding.summary: direction-a needs four registry entries. They belong in packages/ui/src/contracts/index.ts, which is production source and therefore read-only to Preview under CONTEXT-LOCK-6.
blockingFinding.whyTheCandidateCannotWorkAroundIt: Tree imports contractSpec statically from packages/ui/src/contracts. A candidate-local registry cannot be injected, so rendering these nodes artifact-locally would require copying Tree - and a copied frame makes the candidate prove that a facsimile renders, which is the one thing an executable Preview may not do.
blockingFinding.precedent: app-signin-dashboard hit this exactly: its apply-progress records layout-app-chrome and page-dashboard BLOCKED for the same reason. The provisioning case resolved it by the user widening the boundary, recorded as a named deviation with approvedBy: user.
blockingFinding.resolvedBy: the user widened the boundary to that single contracts file

boundaryDeviation.words: Nới cho đúng file contracts (đề xuất)
boundaryDeviation.reason: A closed ContractKey union makes a new node anatomy impossible to express inside the artifact: Tree imports contractSpec statically, so a candidate-local registry would require copying Tree - and the candidate would then be proving that a facsimile renders.
boundaryDeviation.narrowness: Exactly one file. No leaf, branch, composite, block or app source is writable by this phase.
